title: Discovery of a radio jet in the Cloverleaf quasar at z = 2.56
question: Spatially differentiate emission originating from the AGN and host galaxy in the strongly lensed Cloverleaf quasar at z = 2.56 across optical, sub-millimetre, and radio wavelengths to study AGN feedback.

what.value: Lens redshift z = 1.7 and lens configuration (single galaxy and distant cluster)

evidence.quote: We take the assumption from Kneib et al. (1998) that the lens system is contributed by a single galaxy (the narrow absorption systems) and a distant cluster both at z ~ 1.7.
In our lens model, the redshift of the lens plane is set as 1.7 (Kneib et al. 1998).

We use imfit in Common Astronomy Software Applications version 6.1.2.7 (CASA) (McMullin et al. 2007) to fit a star located at (14 : 15 : 47.39856, +11 : 29 : 50.7480) (2MASS id: J14154739+1129507 (Cutri et al. 2003))

recipe.goal: Calibrate, image, and astrometrically align multi-band archival observations
recipe.method: Stack HST ACS F814W images with SWARP; calibrate and image ALMA 300 GHz, VLA 8.4 GHz, VLA 33 GHz, and e-Merlin 1.5 GHz visibility data in CASA with tclean; fit peak positions of the four lensed images in HST and ALMA using SAOimageDS9 and shift HST astrometry to match ALMA.
key_parameters: Astrometric offset applied between HST and ALMA: 0.126'' in R.A. and 0.219'' in Dec.
Uniform restoring beam of 0.25'' x 0.25'' for radio images in spectral index analysis
assumptions: Four lensed images follow Gaussian distributions for size measurements in imfit

recipe.goal: Parametric lens mass and source modelling of HST optical and ALMA 300 GHz continuum images
recipe.method: Fit the HST image in PyAutoLens with an isothermal ellipsoid plus external shear lens model and a point-source model; use the highest-likelihood result as prior/initial input to fit the ALMA 300 GHz continuum image with a power-law ellipsoid plus external shear lens mass model and an elliptical Sérsic source profile, fixing the lens mass centre to the HST result.
key_parameters: Lens plane redshift z = 1.7; source redshift z = 2.56
assumptions: Lens system is a single galaxy and distant cluster at z ~ 1.7 modelled as a power-law ellipsoid with external shear

recipe.goal: Non-parametric source-plane reconstruction of ALMA 300 GHz and radio continuum bands
recipe.method: Reconstruct the 300 GHz source plane iteratively using a magnification-weighted Voronoi grid followed by a brightness-weighted Voronoi mesh while fitting a new power-law ellipsoid plus shear lens mass model; then fix the lens mass model parameters to the 300 GHz non-parametric fit and reconstruct the 1.5, 8.4, and 33 GHz source planes using a magnification-weighted Voronoi mesh.
key_parameters: Magnification-weighted Voronoi mesh for 1.5, 8.4, and 33 GHz reconstructions to ensure identical Voronoi cell grids
assumptions: Fixed lens mass model parameters from ALMA 300 GHz non-parametric fit across all radio bands

recipe.goal: Extract multi-band radio fluxes and fit spectral indices in the lens and source planes
recipe.method: Extract radio fluxes at 1.5, 8.4, and 33 GHz from elliptical apertures in the source plane and lens plane; fit single power-law SEDs and pixel-by-pixel spectral index maps in the source plane and from nterm=2 e-Merlin imaging in the lens plane.
key_parameters: 5-\sigma cutoff mask for e-Merlin lens-plane spectral index map; S/N > 3.5 mask at 33 GHz for source-plane spectral index map
assumptions: Radio continuum SEDs follow a single power-law profile
